title: Experiencing Agency
summary: Helping neighbourhood groups feel welcoming and easy to follow online.
intro: An app for neighbourhood action groups that helps newcomers feel welcome and keeps everyone in the loop. It grew out of two rounds of interviews and three prototypes.
